adaptation_policy: Only local-path/private-publication metadata and two documented machine-specific commands are adapted; all saved JSON numeric observations and64-hex source hashes are preserved.
binding_limit: Original protocols and audit hashes continue to refer to the original archived bytes. Publicly adapted method notes or metadata do not silently rebind those records. Complete historical replay requires omitted raw/original binding material; derived public regeneration needs explicit rebinding in a disposable copy.
omissions: ZIP bundles and their duplicate contents
Cloud Page readbacks, delivery receipts, rendered exports and progress/log files
Old packaging tools and full-archive manifests whose listed raw data are not in the proposed package
Original RUN.txt files contain local environment paths; use portable generated reproduction documentation instead.
